title: Soliskin

{{Terminology Infobox |title = Soliskin |image = Soliskin.png |type = Lore |nation = Lahai-Roi }} {{Quote|Chuuu, Chuuu!}} '''Soliskin''' are a type of [[Exoswarm]] originating from the [[Exostrider]]'s neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness. Soliskin can be found plentifully in the [[Bjartr Woods]], where they will rest and grow to return back to the Solistrees,[[Vitruvio]] although their true target is the great [[Solvein Heartwood]] further below. Large numbers of Soliskin can also be found in the [[Dimmr Plains]]. The Shepherds who act as their guides and caretakers are often overwhelmed with looking after more than twenty Soliskin at once, leaving the abundance of Soliskin that descend from the Solvein Canopy unattended, those Soliskin left to wander throughout the land of Lahai-Roi.[[Lyosroth]] Soliskin are gentle and playful in temperament, they can be found dancing or playing hide-n-seek if not sunbathing. They also seem to enjoy being held and Aksel claims they are happiest when dancing with the Shepards. ==Shepherds== {{Description|Those recognized by the Soliskin become Shepherds, tasked with tending to the Exoswarm in their growth and renewal.|"Where Glommoths Once Roamed" (Excerpt I)}} Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.[[Ode to the Second Sunrise]] Glossary [[Alviss]] explains that while Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods, they do not wish to disturb the Soliskin's home and thus do not live there. At best they pitch a small tent, ensuring the forest remains exclusively for the Soliskin where beyond the Solisylum’s calculation, anything made or connected to humans is not imposed on the woods. He believes that only by laying aside human noise and entering in reverence that those who enter become closer to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition. ==[[Monument of Returning Soliseeds]]== [[File:Soliskin Reunion.png|thumb|150px|Giant Soliskin|left]] Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi. These lost Soliskin can be found and the [[Soliseed of Essehalo|Soliseeds]] they award can be delivered to the [[Giant Soliskin]] who can be found in either the [[Soliseed Plains]] or [[Base Camp]]. There, it will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born. Like plants, the Essehalo floating above the Soliskin grows and bears fruits, which are carefully preserved and later given to those who earn the Soliskin's trust. This is significant because Lyosroth claims that Soliskin treats these seeds as their own offspring. ==Solistree== The Solistrees are towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the [[Heliogyre]]. ==Rite of Return== A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise. The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider. ==Gallery== Soliskin Variants.png|Different Type of Soliskin found throughout Lahai-Roi. ==Trivia== * Rover apparently has {{tt|an aura|"Oh, guest from afar... You carry an aura not unlike that of the Soliskin."
-Royan at the entrance of Haldarheim}} similar to a Soliskin. * Exoenergy is produced when the Soliskin absorb the Reactor’s rays and some excess energy spills into the surrounding environment. Collecting it grants a movement speed boost for the player. * Soliskin are more dexterous than they may appear at first, being capable of riding Exploration Motorbikes. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Soliskin |zhs = 日灵 |zht = 日靈 |ja = 太陽の精霊 |ko = 태양의 정령 |fr = Solisiens |de = Solislinge |es = Solistirpes |th = เหล่า Soliskin |pt = Solispíritos }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.0}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Lore Navbox|Terminology}}
